description: Checked: Checks the "Download Public Folder Favorites" option in the Advanced tab of the Microsoft Exchange Server dialog box (More Settings button in the E-mail Accounts dialog box) and enables the option. This enables Public Folder Favorites synchronization in Cached Exchange mode. | Unchecked: Unchecks the "Download Public Folder Favorites" option in the Advanced tab of the Microsoft Exchange Server dialog box (More Settings button in the E-mail Accounts dialog box) and disables the option. This disables Public Folder Favorites synchronization in Cached Exchange mode.
